name: Dooku's lightsaber
description: Dooku's lightsaber, also known as Darth Tyranus' lightsaber, or Dooku's Sith lightsaber, was the personal curved-hilt lightsaber of Dooku, the Count of Serenno. The former Jedi Master, who became Darth Tyranus and the political leader of the Separatist Alliance, constructed the weapon's unique hilt with a kyber crystal that emitted a red blade. As the apprentice of the Dark Lord of the Sith, Darth Sidious, Dooku used the Sith blade against his foes.
